title: fix(spec)!: composeStacks refuses a datasource whose external.connector names no connector instance the composed inputs declare
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiAgqyfAMFoGxrddntu1VW4z)_

**Full review owed at the reviewer tier.** Developed on the default tier while the reviewer tier's quota is out. This PR touches the published spec (`packages/spec/src/**`), so it lands only after a full review at the reviewer tier and a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review record PASS on the current head.

Fixes #27803

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #27786 (it teaches `external.connector` in the datasources skill rule and the two data-modeling guides; the composed check applies that same rule, with the same findings, so it adds nothing an author writes differently)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `composeStacks` 合成多个栈时，按所有输入的 `connectors` 检查每个数据源的 `external.connector`：名字不存在、只是目录描述（无 `provider`）、实例没有 `auth`，三种情况都在构建时拒收，提示与单栈 `defineStack` 完全一致。另附三处只改注释的小修（`injected-system-column-provenance.ts` 两处、`IDataEngine.listDatasourceDefs` 一处）。
- **为什么改：** 单栈严格构建已拒收写错的连接器名，但以 `strict: false` 构建的输入会把悬空的名字带进合成产物，作者要到首次连接才发现。
- **风险与回滚：** 只收窄合成层的接受集；被拒的都是作者写错的引用。跨输入的正确配对（数据源在 A 包、连接器实例在 B 包）照常通过。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 新增的 `collectComposedDatasourceConnectorErrors` 及其在 `composeStacks` 第 3b 步的调用；`stack-datasource-connector.test.ts` 新增的 composeStacks 一组。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-datasource-connector.test.ts`，预期 25 个测试全过。
- **需要您做的：** 无，席位落地（需审阅档全量复审与合约复审 PASS）。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`:** a new `collectComposedDatasourceConnectorErrors(stacks, preserve)` runs `collectDatasourceConnectorErrors` over the `datasources` and the `connectors` of every input, in the shape of `collectComposedExternalBindingDatasourceErrors`. `composeStacks` calls it in step 3b, the artifact cross-reference pass, so its findings arrive under the same `StackCrossReferenceError` (`STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, 422) and read exactly as the per-stack ones do.
  - It newly refuses a dangling name, a catalog descriptor (no `provider`) or an instance with no `auth` (or `auth: { type: 'none' }`) carried by an input built with `strict: false`.
  - A datasource in one input that borrows an instance another input declares composes.
  - `providedCollectionEntries` reads each input's top level and every `packages[]` body (the `providedFlowNames` reading), so a nested multi-package input is judged on what its package bodies carry. An entry object a nested input holds in both halves is read once.
  - A connector name declared more than once is judged by registration slot. In one slot (the flattened artifact's one package, or one package body) the later entry is the one the registry keeps; when it cannot lend but an earlier one could, the finding names both declarations and prescribes the duplicate's fix. In two slots (two packages of a `preserve` artifact, or a package body beside the flattened top level) the registry keeps both and the lender answers the first registered, so when one entry can lend and the other cannot, the borrow is refused as ambiguous in either declaration order. When both can lend, it composes.
  - The per-stack collector gains an optional `shadowedLender` hook for the duplicate's prescription, and three small predicates (`connectorHasProvider`, `connectorHasCredential`, `connectorCanLend`) shared by both collectors. All module-private.
- **Doc-only should-fixes** (scope additions on the card):
  - `isInjectedColumnDefinition`: plugin-sharing's `equalsShippedDef` copy is gone (it reads `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable`), so plugin-security's is the one left.
  - `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable`'s fail direction: ordinary owner scoping on a column the remote lacks matches no row or raises (Postgres and MySQL raise, SQLite matches no row); neither widens.
  - `IDataEngine.listDatasourceDefs?`: each entry carries the stored `driver` id, and omits the key for a definition that never named one (checked against `ObjectQL.listDatasourceDefs` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`).
- **`.changeset/27803-composed-datasource-connector.md`:** `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, the two declaration lines, a **BREAKING** banner naming every CLI command that loads a composed project, and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

## Why

The contract review of PR #27783 (record 6511230689, should-fix d) left the composed counterpart of the `external.connector` check out of that PR. D7 ruling 6486136301: "refused at build when the named instance is not declared". A composition is a build too.

## Verification

All on head `1f471e09`.

- **Tests** in `packages/spec/src/stack-datasource-connector.test.ts`: 25, of which 17 in the `composeStacks` group. A cross-input pair composes in both orders under `last` and `preserve`; a dangling name in a `strict: false` input is refused under both; a descriptor and an auth-less instance another input declares are refused with their findings; a name declared twice in the flattened artifact is judged against the later entry and its finding names both declarations; two packages of a `preserve` artifact that disagree on whether their entry can lend are refused as ambiguous in both orders, and two lending packages compose in both orders; a nested multi-package input is read through its package bodies (a borrower resolves against a body's instance, a body's datasource is judged, a body beside another input's top level counts as two slots), and an entry it carries in both halves is read once; the per-stack strict refusal is unchanged. Each refusal asserts the envelope (`STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, 422), one finding, and the `composeStacks artifact cross-reference validation failed (1 issue):` header.
- **Ablations** (each on a committed fix, restored by a trap): the new call removed from `composeStacks`, 4 of the first 8 cases red; package bodies not read, the 3 nested cases red; the identity de-duplication removed, the both-halves case red; every entry put in one slot, the 2 `preserve` ambiguity cases and the body-beside-top-level case red. The other cases stayed green each time.
- **Package:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `test` and `typecheck` under the verify lock: build exit 0; 756 test files passed, 22498 tests passed (1 todo); typecheck passed.
- **Local gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, derived after merging `origin/main`, named 82 families; all were run with exit codes recorded before any pipe. `check:type-check-debt` exited 3 until a `pnpm install` picked up the lockfile change `main` brought, then exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". `check-adr-0087-registration` accepts the changeset's disposition, and `check-changeset-no-major` with this body passes (`patch`, a non-protocol narrowing). No generated reference moved. The full gate battery is CI's.
- **Dogfood battery** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), after building the closure, under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 357 passed, 3 skipped (360); Tests 2875 passed, 20 skipped (2895); no failure.

## Acceptance notes

- **A duplicated connector name is judged per registration slot.** The registry keys a package-owned item by package id and name, and the lender answers the first registered entry of a name, so last-wins holds only inside one slot. This is beyond the card's three named tests and is pinned in both orders.
- **The refusal reaches every CLI command that loads a composed project** (`os build`, `os validate`, `os lint`, `os dev`, `os serve`), because the author's config runs `composeStacks`; the changeset says so.
- **Not covered by this PR:** strict `defineStack` still resolves `external.connector` against its own stack only, so a package can borrow a sibling package's instance only by building the borrower with `strict: false`. An `artifactConnectors` promise of the `artifactFlows` shape would close that; it is the epic PM's to card.
- **Worktree:** `objectstack-issue-27803` on the claimed branch, as the Claim names.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: no generated artifact changes (only JSDoc and a build-time collector; the gate run left the tree clean).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's own Chinese reader section).
